title: Not good enough
text: Not good enough. I had hopes that these shears would be a good replacement for my OXO shears that are 6-10 years old. They aren’t. The shears I bought at the Dollar Tree are sturdier. The package looked like it was put through the wringer.  The free erecipe book is nonexistent since the web address leads you only to Amazon.  The warranty is useless without  a way to contact the manufacturer.  Do yourself a favor and buy quality products.
